scope: Independent method and ledger-audit design for two fixed EX024 first-break-state accounts, C0057/C0058. No new replay or upstream by reviewer.
hypothesis_boundary: EX023 original first-break labels are seen-data exploratory evidence. Positive P group15 versus nonpositive85 has different observed same-entry early-exit increments, but both tails and yearly counterexamples remain.
Paired labels omit unmatched or either-leg open cases; conditional account paths may change and cannot be formed by adding those labels. Two complementary policies retain both competing outcomes.
causal_contract: At actual BUY E reset break_checked and capture actual public fill price; support remains prior-five completed evaluation closes.

At first support break strictly before E+9 only, calculate P=normalized actual-close/(actual normalized fill price*1.001)-1. P>0 selects profit branch, P<=0 selects nonpositive branch, including exactly zero. No prospective sell fee.

Evaluate only once per actual holding cycle. Rejecting early exit permanently ignores later support breaks in that cycle. E+9 close emits time exit unconditionally; E+9 first break is not an early classification.
Once SELL is emitted it remains latched until actual full fill. No reassessment during blocked SELL. Actual entry day can trigger the first break.
Reservation=actual BUY index+10 survives SELL and flat; next actual BUY resets. Required sell is never delayed by reservation. No future B shadow or same-session round trip.
independent_audit: Reuse EX017 canonical ledger audit for actual orders, fills, quantities, price ticks, fees, residual cash, full-cash lots and identical BuyHold.

Reconstruct every support floor, entry/deadline, retained reservation and first-break state directly from actual fills and normalized account closes. Compare event flags, zero-on-nonevent P, selected/rejected branch, held-state break_checked and actual-fill price observation.
Require exact two new C0057/C0058 identities and authenticated original B/C0056 evidence reuse; bind source SHA, precheck and runtime closure.
Report first-break positive/nonpositive/selected/rejected counts and actual suspension sample count; absence of actual suspension does not imply real-world branch validation.
limitations: Positive original group removal of its best five pairs turns mean negative;2021/2023 nonpositive early exit had protective increments. Neither is a new hard acceptance gate.
2024 had zero profitable first-break pairs in original matched evidence; this exit change alone is not presumed to cure entry losses.
All7 original annual return/drawdown targets and60*CLOSED/1642 frequency remain unchanged; no yearly switching or nearby threshold search.
Public finite observations do not disclose future state. New full-path outcomes, not labels or audit PASS, determine economic progress.
